active_read_scope: Shu non-normal S3 plan only; no read in normal phase or S1/S2/otherowner
actual_API_qualification: _prepare_damage rejects skill unlock_elite > requested elite before engine; elite<2 rank>7 also rejected
Qt_producer: bool default creates QCheckBox, isChecked() submits bool only for current owner/allowed skill; untouched
condition_source: Ground enemy on a sown tile during S3 grants e_atk/e_attack_speed to allied units in skill range; this API manually declares that condition, without actual target position sampling
unknowns: actual ground-enemy presence and tile occupancy
four_sui periodic SP pulse phase and full resource clock
scope_excludes: new skill damage model or new native source event
actual_Qt_skill_choices: choices=[i+1 for i,s in enumerate(profile[skills]) if s.get(unlock_elite,i)<=elite]
actual_Qt_serializer: owner==current operator and selected skill in allowed skills; QCheckBox uses isChecked()
